details: CONFIRMED by reading and a probe. The brief asked to reuse the existing reader; on master the only one is a method of the guard hook
(not importable) and the setup's gitignore helper, so "reuse" needed a shared reader in relay_config, which the lane-start lane is
adding right now (relay_config.worktrees_folder). The project's Python rule: a record several programs read has one parser shared by
all of them. With two copies the values with "/", "../" or an absolute path already give different answers, and a later change of the
rule (the next folder form) must be made in four places. The worker did not raise it as a Gap.
Severity MEDIUM: breaks the brief's recorded decision (front's, owner can reverse) and the project's one-parser rule; the divergent
values are not used by any project today (all kit.toml values found are ".worktree"/".worktrees"), so no live attribution is wrong.
Size: 15 agent minutes after the lane-start change lands (take master, call relay_config.worktrees_folder, compare by path).
evidence: + def worktrees_folder(main: str) -> str: ... return os.path.normpath(os.path.join(main, folder or ".worktrees"))
git grep: lib/relay_setup.py:637 folder = project.get("worktrees"); plugins/relay/hooks/guard_main.py:231 wt = self.get("project", "worktrees")
failing_case: The brief's decision: "reuse the reader the guard and lane start already use, no new copy of the rule". The change adds
relay_estimate.worktree_folder, a new reader that returns a bare name; readers now: relay_setup.py:637, guard_main.py:231,
relay_estimate.py:41, and (parallel lane wt/relay-s-lane-start-hardcodes-main-worktr) relay_config.worktrees_folder, which returns
an absolute path and accepts "../x" and absolute values. Where they disagree (probe at head):
- kit.toml worktrees = "../out-wt", brief "Worktree: <parent>/out-wt/fx (branch wt/fx)": change_of(root, brief, root=root) -> None; should be "fx".
- kit.toml worktrees = "/abs/wt" (absolute): change_of(root, "Worktree: /abs/wt/fx", root=root) -> None (the name becomes "abs/wt").
After both lanes land, lane start would create lanes where relay_config says and cost attribution would look where its own copy says.
fix_hint: Land after the lane-start change (or move its relay_config.worktrees_folder here first): drop relay_estimate.worktree_folder; in
against realpath'd paths in the text; in repo_top compare dirname(folder) with relay_config.worktrees_folder of the candidate repo.
pass_cases: 1. kit.toml worktrees = ".worktree": change_of(root, "Worktree: <root>/.worktree/fx (branch wt/fx)", root=root) -> "fx" (works today).
2. No kit.toml: change_of("<root>/.worktrees/fx/lib", "", root=root) -> "fx" and repo_top("<root>/.worktrees/fx") -> root (works today).
3. kit.toml worktrees = "build/wt": repo_top("<root>/build/wt/fx") -> root; change_of("<root>/build/wt/fx/lib", "", root=root) -> "fx".
4. git grep 'get("worktrees")\|"project", "worktrees"\|project.worktrees' over lib/ shows relay_estimate using relay_config's reader, not its own.
reason: relay_estimate now calls relay_config.worktrees_folder (lib/relay_estimate.py:46) but squeezes the absolute path back into a bare name, so the forms still diverge. Probe: kit.toml ../out-wt: change_of with brief "Worktree: <parent>/out-wt/fx" -> None; /abs/wt: -> None; build/wt: change_of ok but repo_top("<root>/build/wt/fx") != root (repo_top takes dirname twice, so it asks worktree_folder of <root>/build). Pass cases 1,2 hold; 3 fails for repo_top and the out-of-root folders. The fixer said "Outside" (needs the lane-start lane); that lane's relay_config.worktrees_folder is now in the tree, so the dependency is gone. Fixer line Outside: my view, no longer valid.

details: CONFIRMED by probe (worktree_of unanchored -> "fx"; change_of with cwd under .worktree and root -> "fx", so behaviour is right today).
Correct today for every value in use; fragile and under-tested. Size: 10 agent minutes.
evidence: probe: worktree_of wt unanchored: fx ; alix cwd root: fx
git grep -n 'worktree_of(' lib: only relay_estimate.py:111 and :118, both without folder.
failing_case: worktree_of("/x/relay/lib/newt/fx", "wt") -> "fx" (the folder is matched inside "newt"); should be None.
No production code passes `folder` to worktree_of (change_of calls worktree_of(cwd) only when root is None), so pass case 1 is met
only through a parameter nothing uses. The brief's own failing case, an ALIX agent working in <root>/.worktree/fx/lib, and the brief's
"Test with transcripts whose paths use .worktree/ and .worktrees/" have no test: removing the cwd branch of change_of for root would
leave all 26 tests green only if the brief-line test still passes (it does, through the same regex), so the cwd route is untested.
fix_hint: Anchor the regex on "/" before the folder, drop the unused `folder` parameter (or use it), and add the cwd-under-.worktree and
pass_cases: 1. kit.toml ".worktree": change_of("<root>/.worktree/fx/lib", "", root=root) -> "fx" (a test asserts it).
2. agent_rows over a fake transcript whose first cwd is "<root>/.worktree/fx" -> one row with change "fx".
